thread:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for 'backend-gateway@2026-04-02' — publish verification failed: post-finalize digest mismatch (index=sha256:fa12be34 actual=sha256:fa12bb33). Automatic canary hold engaged.

sam: saw this during the 30m change window. CI publish says success but verify failed immediately after finalize. no network errors in the job.

lee: i pulled the object from storage and verified locally: matches actual=sha256:fa12bb33. Looks like the index was updated with the wrong digest. Could be a race between the publisher and an indexer job.

nina: if we let this go we'll risk serving a build that doesn't match provenance. option A: pin to previous stable 2026-04-01, option B: force-promote and re-sign artifact (risky), option C: block and triage.

release-manager: don't force-promote. we have a 45m change window. prefer pin to 2026-04-01 to keep downstream deploys moving. open a follow-up ticket to triage publisher/indexer race and add post-finalize verification.

sre-oncall: i'll check for storage-side anomalies and multipart finalize logs. will open INC-2026-058 if we see multiple finalize errors.

sam: running pin now:
```bash
deploybot pin --service backend-gateway --image 2026-04-01 --reason "post-finalize digest mismatch 2026-04-02"
```

deploy-bot: Pin applied. Canary now routing to 2026-04-01.

release-manager: updating release notes: "Canary for backend-gateway (2026-04-02) held due to artifact digest mismatch between index and storage. Rolled back to 2026-04-01. Investigation ticket ARTIFACT-1477 opened."

lee: ARTIFACT-1477 created. immediate remediation plan: 1) Add a post-finalize fetch+verify step in publisher; 2) Block concurrent index writes for the same key using a lease; 3) Add CI check that verifies digest after publish before marking index live.

nina: agree. add an integration test for concurrent publishes to catch races.

sre-oncall: no widespread S3 errors but saw 2 failed finalize attempts in eu-central during that minute. correlating. incident created if trend continues.

release-manager: decision: apply pin for this service only; continue other promotes. we'll revisit after ARTIFACT-1477 owner triage tomorrow. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
